newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: STEEL GROUP ISPAT SHARE OPTION EXCERISED.
newsitem.headline: STEEL GROUP ISPAT SHARE OPTION EXCERISED.

text.p: Steel group Ispat International said on Thursday Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette and Credit Suisse First Boston, joint global co-ordinators and underwriters of its Initial Public Offering, had exercised their greenshoe option.

The option was exercised to subscribe for and increase the offering size by an additional 3,750,000 Class A common shares, from the controlling shareholder, following a succesfull initial placing of 25,000,000 Class A common shares.
The total number of Class A shares now issued are 28.75 million, which has raised $776.25 million.
Ispat shares were trading at 60.00 guilders on Thursday, down 0.60 guilders.
